# AnimeNest
> AnimeNest is a free anime streaming website offering Hindi Dub, English Sub, and Multi-Audio anime series and movies.

## Main Pages
- [Home](/): Browse trending, popular, and latest anime.
- [Trending Anime](/trending): Most watched anime right now.
- [Anime Movies](/movies): Collection of anime movies.
- [Cartoons](/cartoons): Collection of cartoon series.

## Important Note
We do not host any videos. We only provide embedded links from third-party providers.
